exposure: volume of formula consumed on day 1 of life (DOL1)
cohort: The study included 1106 full-term, formula-fed infants born between January 2008 and December 2012 who continued care at the same institution.
finding: Infants overfed on the first day of life were significantly more likely to be overweight or obese at their 4th year well-child check-up.
